card.name: Scattered words inside drug-label sentences
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words in drug-label text, such as a verb after 'will', the start of 'ferritin', or 'treatment' after 'antipsychotic'.

modes.label: Verb after may/will
modes.description: A verb such as reduce or attenuate right after a modal in an effect statement.
modes.example: by younger women will<< reduce>> peak bone mass and increase the risk for

modes.label: Start of ferritin
modes.description: The first piece of 'ferritin' after 'serum' in dose-adjustment rules.
modes.example: Interrupt treatment when serum<< ferr>>itin is less than 300

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A piece of a drug or drug-class name partway through the word.
modes.example: In the study, normal mice were given<< sor>>afenib
